subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Zhuhan, who is in charge of registration for The Crux Clash
Take part in the tournament and win

20010201.text: Hahaha, I knew I wouldn't regret introducing you as the favorite!

20010202.text: #So what do you think, Kazuha? {F#She}{M#He} totally dominated that guy, and did it with style, too.

20010203.text: Impressive. But I also observed our favorite exercise some restraint, as if to protect the opponent from serious harm.

20010204.text: #Well, I've fought my fair share of battles, both big and small. And I say, after the show {F#she}{M#he} put on just now, {F#she}{M#he}'s more than convinced me of {F#her}{M#his} ability.

20010205.text: So come on, we all know you've got a wide vocabulary in there — can't you spare a word or two to congratulate our up-and-coming champion?

20010206.text: Alright... Let me think how to aptly phrase these words of praise...

20010208.text: Ugh, alright then. I was thinking your inner poet might want to join in the fun, but... I guess I shouldn't put you on the spot like that.

20010209.text: You know, a lot of competitors came to me saying how surprised they were that Liyue's hero was entering the tournament...

20010210.text: ...And since you signed up, we've had many others do the same, with more than a few top-tier fighters among them. I'm sure lots of them are here to find out how they stack up against you.

20010213.text: Haha, well, since everyone sees you as the one to beat, I figured I should start treating you that way, too.

20010214.text: For one thing, we don't want you wasting all your energy in the early rounds fighting people who are well below your level. Not to mention... you must be itching to fight someone in your league, too, right?

20010215.text: So, I'm putting you straight through to the semi-finals!

20010216.text: Huh? But we only just started the qualifiers... Seems like a crazy system if we just skip straight to the semi-finals.

20010217.text: This is how Captain Beidou works. You won't persuade her otherwise.

20010218.text: Besides, at your level, you would have made it to the semi-finals anyway.

20010219.text: Huh. To be fair, Paimon was thinking that too...

20010220.text: Alright, I'm gonna watch some more of the tournament. If there's any potential contenders for you out there, I want to know who they are and what they're about.

20010221.text: We're finally here, folks! The real show is about to begin!

20010222.text: Hehe... the captain seems to have high hopes for this tournament. I have not seen her so excited in quite some time.

20010223.text: Your opponent has fought many rounds to get to the semi-finals. This makes him a seasoned warrior.

20010224.text: You may well be stronger than him, but this should not give you cause to lower your guard.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Zhuhan again and enter the next round

20010401.text: Your opponent in the semi-finals is new to The Crux Clash, but he has quickly become the dark horse of the tournament.

20010402.text: I do not doubt your abilities, but I would suggest that you make sure you are fully prepared before you begin.

20010403.text: #Relax! My {F#girl}{M#guy}'s at the top of {F#her}{M#his} game, {F#she}{M#he} ain't gonna lose!

20010407.text: Don't worry, take some time to compose yourself.

20010601.text: I'm sweating all over. It's a good feeling.

20010602.text: Congratulations, I was beaten by the best. I need to train harder.

20010605.text: Right! For a moment there, Paimon was a little worried...

20010606.text: If you had a Vision, you'd definitely be one of the strongest around.

20010607.text: I wanted a Vision, once, when I was a kid. People said that if you're strong enough you'll have your chance to get one.

20010609.text: I lost interest, eventually. You can't depend on a Vision like you can your own body.

20010610.text: I've fought and won against Vision bearers before. The power they have was given to them by the gods. I don't envy it.

20010611.text: Huh? You mean, you didn't sign up to try and get your hands on that Masterless Vision?

20010612.text: No, I didn't. I only wanted to pit myself against other fighters and see who was the strongest.

20010613.text: Only in defeat can you understand your weaknesses and learn from them. So, I'm pleased with today's outcome. I don't often have the pleasure of experiencing defeat.

20010614.text: Wow... now that's true strength talking!

20010615.text: If you have the chance in the future, please come and spar with me again. I will be stronger next time.

20010617.text: By the way... do you know who else made it into the finals? ...Is it gonna be someone even tougher than you?

20010618.text: Whether they'll be as tough as me I don't know... But what I have heard is that they're extremely quick.

subQuests.subQuestName: Ask around for info about your final opponent

20010701.text: Ah, it's you, haha! I watched your match. What a stunning performance!

20010702.text: I myself was eliminated in the third round. *sigh* Shame... If only I could have advanced one more round...

20010703.text: Ah, maybe next time, huh? By the way, do you happen to know who else advanced to the final round?

20010704.text: Why, yes. He's the same one who defeated me. He is a formidable opponent, quick on his feet and swift to take advantage of his opponent's missteps.

20010705.text: I faltered for but a brief moment, but before I knew it, he had me on the floor.

20010706.text: Given my stature, I have no fear of squaring off with physically strong opponents. But faced with a nimble, agile opponent such as him... I found myself completely out of my league...

20010707.text: Still — I'm sure he'll be no match for you, haha!

subQuests.subQuestName: Continue asking around for more info about your final opponent

20010801.text: Hey there... uh, but where did the other guy go?

20010802.text: He tried to use force dispersal to deflect a punch, but instead he took it straight to the nose. There was blood all over the place...

20010803.text: His opponent was pretty freaked out by it. He kept asking him "why didn't you dodge?" But he was pretty much out cold by that point and couldn't reply.

20010804.text: "Why don't you dodge?" they ask... Because to not dodge is the very essence of Lingshan Clan kung fu. It's just that he hadn't quite mastered it yet.

20010806.text: Don't even get me started... I spent all my energy helping him get from here to the boat to take him back to the harbor. But by the time I got back, my scheduled match time had already passed, and I had to forfeit.

20010807.text: I don't dare tell my master about this... Otherwise, I'd never hear the end of it.

20010808.text: Sorry, I shouldn't be complaining in front of you like this. I'm afraid I'm still a bit out of sorts at the moment, so I probably won't be able to help you with whatever you were here to ask me about.

20010809.text: Oh, alright then... hope your buddy makes a swift recovery. Hang in there!

subQuests.subQuestName: Ask Beidou and Kazuha about your final opponent

20010901.text: You gave an outstanding performance. Truly commendable.

20010902.text: I could sense that you are not familiar with bouts of this kind, and it could have cost you the match.

20010903.text: But you were quick to adapt, and managed to claim victory over your opponent. That is a most invaluable skill.

20010906.text: In fact, I discerned this not from what I saw, but what I heard — the ground beneath your feet and the pattern of your breathing. But it is nothing remarkable, for I discerned nothing more than Captain Beidou did.

20010907.text: Ahaha, he's right. But in my case, I was purely relying on previous experience.

20010908.text: I guess not using your elemental powers must be quite new for you, huh?

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow Kazuha to a more peaceful location

20011101.text: Now that we're alone, let me cut to the heart of the matter...

20011102.text: You are skilled in manipulating the elements. And not just a single element, but multiple. Is that correct?

20011105.text: Paimon knew that you were hinting at something from the moment we met. You've known all along.

20011106.text: That's right. If the other contenders were to catch wind of your elemental abilities, let's just say it would cause some unwanted misunderstandings.

20011107.text: If I'm not mistaken, you share these considerations, given your reluctance to use elemental skills even in the heat of a match.

20011108.text: Yes, but how did you know?

20011109.text: Hehe, when I talk about that which I see or hear in you, this is not poetic symbolism at play. I mean these things in the truest sense possible.

20011110.text: Since a young age, I have been attuned to the tidings of nature. I hear the breath of the wind and the whispers of the leaves.

20011111.text: It is things of this nature that I also hear from within you, nothing more.

20011112.text: As crazy as all that sounds, somehow Paimon still believes you.

20011113.text: My humble abilities are negligible compared to your incredible feats.

20011114.text: To think a human could wield the elements without a Vision...

20011115.text: And not to mention your incredibly complex scent, like that of some mysterious being...

20011116.text: Hey, stop evaluating us based on our smell! It's weird!

20011117.text: Could you perchance enlighten me as to how you managed to obtain your combined elemental abilities?

subQuests.subQuestName: Defeat the monsters to show Kazuha your elemental abilities

20011301.text: Hmm, your skills in battle are truly beyond reproach. Even with your opponent's speed, he shouldn't be able to overwhelm you.

20011302.text: Your opponent is skilled at controlling his breathing and maintaining balance, which enables him to execute moves that many would find impossible.

20011303.text: He relies entirely on the element of surprise to defeat his opponents.

20011304.text: In other words, as long as you remain mindful of his ability to detect weak points, then his attacks should pose no threat to you.

20011305.text: Thank you, I will not underestimate him.

20011306.text: Please, save your thanks. If anything, I should be thanking you for the opportunity to witness your command of the elements that defies all known principles.

20011307.text: The world is a truly mysterious place, it seems, and one will always encounter that which is still unknown.

20011308.text: You seem kinda obsessed with Visions... but don't you already have your own? Why are you so intent on exploring the connection between Visions and the elements?

20011309.text: I desire to know what meaning Visions have to the gods.

20011310.text: And what influences the gods' decision to grant humans these Visions.

20011311.text: My apologies, you must be completely in the dark regarding such matters.

20011312.text: For allowing me the honor of witnessing your mystical ways, I am willing to answer any questions you may have regarding Inazuma.

20011313.text: I am indeed in the dark, so please enlighten me.

20011314.text: So that's what you're curious about? Haha, then allow me to tell you more.

20011315.text: As you well know, a Vision Hunt Decree is currently underway in Inazuma.

20011316.text: Visions are a gift bestowed by the divine. People that have accepted this gift are now having their Visions confiscated inexplicably, sometimes in circumstances that leave their original recipients dead.

20011317.text: In the outset, supposing each of the Seven Archons had their criteria for granting Visions to living beings — then, does the current Electro Archon now doubt these criteria, or even the act in and of itself?

20011318.text: Not to mention, with no new Electro Visions having been granted for such a long time, it would seem that we can infer something of the Raiden Shogun's feelings on the matter...

20011319.text: She sounds less like an archon and more like... a tyrant.

20011320.text: As far as I know, she is an archon that pursues "eternity." She will relentlessly carry out her will with no regard to what others may think or feel.

20011321.text: Liyue's "contracts" are meant to benefit all who reside within Liyue. But what does Inazuma's pursuit of "eternity" bring to its people?

20011322.text: ...It goes without saying that the people locked within Inazuma do not fare well these days.

20011323.text: Sounds a lot like something the god you encountered in the beginning would do.

20011324.text: Oh? Have you encountered the Electro Archon before?

20011327.text: With time, we will change. But the shogun will remain the same.

20011328.text: If you wish to find her, she will forever be there.

20011329.text: There will come a day when I too shall wish to understand the answers to "eternity" from her.

20011330.text: Ah! The time for your match is approaching.

20011331.text: Oh, right! We got so distracted talking about Inazuma that Paimon forgot all about the tournament!

20011332.text: If you have no other matters to attend to, then we can return together.

20012201.text: Kazuha has had his eye on you from the moment you arrived.

20012202.text: If you've got anything to ask him, this'll be your chance.

20012301.text: Hmm... You control the elements without a Vision, that means...

20012302.text: Oh, pay no attention to me, I was just talking to myself. Ahem... I will be sure to observe your battle intently.

20019906.text: At last, the moment we've all been waiting for — the semi-finals have begun!

20019907.text: Who's it going to be this time — the hero, or the dark horse?

20019908.text: The extraordinary prize is now but a step away for the victor!

20019909.text: I don't care about the prize...

20019910.text: You're a strong opponent. That's what I'm here for.

411151001.text: Please exercise extreme caution. Do not touch the meteorites with your bare hands.

411151101.text: Please keep a safe distance from the meteorites. Only approach the impact site if you have business concerning the meteorites.

411151201.text: Thank you all! I must get back to the Winery and let everyone know that I'm safe.

411151301.text: Huh...? W—Was I asleep? ...Gosh, how long was I out?

411151401.text: May the Anemo Archon spare you from the effects of the meteorites.

411151501.text: Leave the patrolling of the area to me! ...But as far as dealing with the meteorites goes, I've heard you're the ones who know what you're doing?

411151601.text: I haven't had a moment's rest since the meteorite strikes started... Now I think about it, the sleepers don't have it so bad, do they?

411151701.text: While the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never prevail. Please report any new incidents to me.

411151801.text: *yawn* ...Hmm? What're you staring at me for?

411151901.text: Now I'm awake, can I go back home? I just want to go home...

411152001.text: I hear you've been clearing away the meteorites? Nice work! There's a lot to be said for being young and fit, I suppose!

411152101.text: Meteorites, can you believe it... First time for everything, I guess!

411152201.text: Hey, who's that! ...Oh, you're the adventurers here to help out. Sorry. Your help is greatly appreciated.

411152301.text: This has been a long shift... I'm getting hungry.

411152401.text: Something about watching these people sleeping is making me sleepy, too... Ahem! No, I would never sleep on the job!

411152501.text: A bowl of piping hot food right after I woke up... Just what I needed!

411152601.text: The victim is still deep in sleep.
